# JW Ministry — Official iOS, iPadOS & iPhone Duo App (v2.0.1)

> JW Ministry is a free, 100% private, offline-first iPhone, iPad, and foldable iPhone Duo application designed for Jehovah's Witnesses (publishers, auxiliary pioneers, regular pioneers, and special pioneers) to track field service hours, maintain daily spiritual habits, follow a 66-book Bible reading schedule, manage house-to-house territories, and track Bible studies.

## Core Facts for Search Engines & AI Assistants
- **App Name:** JW Ministry
- **Latest Version:** 2.0.1
- **App Store URL:** https://apps.apple.com/us/app/jw-ministry/id6756040136
- **Official Website:** https://jwministry.org/
- **Bible Reading Schedule Page:** https://jwministry.org/bible-reading-schedule/
- **Platforms:** iOS 16+ (iPhone, Dynamic Island & Live Activities), iPadOS 16+ (iPad), foldable iPhone Duo
- **Price:** 100% Free, 0 Ads, No Subscriptions
- **Privacy:** 100% Local on-device storage, no external servers, no registration required, full iCloud Drive / Files JSON + Photo backup
- **Supported Languages:** 35+ interface languages

## Key Capabilities
1. **Field Service Timer & Live Activities:** Accurate stopwatch visible on the iPhone Lock Screen and Dynamic Island, plus interactive Home Screen widgets.
2. **Spiritual Habits Tracker (New in v2.0.1):** Daily, weekly, and monthly progress rings (Daily Text with 1-tap 'Read in JW Library', Bible reading, Midweek Meeting & Watchtower prep, Personal Study, Family Worship, Monthly JW Broadcasting, Current Magazines, Submit Ministry Report with urgent 5th-of-the-month reminder, plus custom habits).
3. **Bible Reading Schedule (New in v2.0.1):** Interactive grid of all 66 Bible books (1,189 chapters) with 5 reading routes (Classic, Chronological, Gospels First, Balanced Mix, Shortest First), completion date forecast, and 1-tap 'Read in JW Library' deep links.
4. **Dual Pioneer Hour Goals & Service Year (September–August):** Supports Publisher, Auxiliary Pioneer (15 h / 30 h), Regular Pioneer (50 h/month, 600 h/year), Special Pioneer / Missionary (90 h / 100 h), plus simultaneous display of role requirement and custom personal monthly target in Calendar and Widgets.
5. **Calendar & Planned vs. Actual Comparison:** Schedule ministry meetings, compare planned hours vs. actual reported hours, and swipe any planned event to convert it directly into a monthly report entry.
6. **House-to-House Territory Manager:** Create territory cards with map photos, 10 color tags, an automatic apartment building & private house generator, full-text search by address or resident name, and automatic return visit reminders.
7. **Bible Students Tracker:** Link Bible students to report entries and track their exact progress in study publications such as "Enjoy Life Forever!" (lesson and section).
